description: A React component that renders a list of configuration options for language models, allowing users to select models, adjust parameters like temperature and top_p, and toggle settings such as inject system prompts and memory inclusion. It manages updates via provided callbacks and uses external hooks and validators.

methods.name: ModelConfigList
methods.description: React functional component rendering a list of model configuration options with inputs for model selection, temperature, top_p, max tokens, penalties, templates, history count, compression threshold, and memory toggle.
